steps.title: Retrieval query
steps.notice: The query is built from the invoice line — vendor, description, amount, cost centre — not from a blank prompt.

steps.title: Top 3 retrieved lines
steps.notice: The model sees confirmed historical lines. Rank is what the retriever returned, not what the model wished were true.

fields.value: Sample Vendor A — Platform subscription — GL 6100 — confirmed (synthetic)
Sample Vendor A — Software licence — GL 6100 — confirmed (synthetic)
Sample Vendor B — IT services — GL 6240 — confirmed (synthetic)

steps.title: Prompt summary
steps.notice: The model is asked to generalise from those confirmed lines and to return a code plus a confidence. It is not asked to memorise a rule.

fields.label: Instruction
fields.value: Propose one GL code and a confidence score from the retrieved confirmed lines. Include the reasoning. Do not propose a code none of the examples support. (Summary of the prompt, not the production template.)

steps.title: Proposed code
steps.notice: 0.94 is the model's confidence on this line. It is a proposal until the gate accepts it.

steps.title: Gate decision
steps.notice: The gate decides the write, not the model. The 0.90 threshold is part of this simplified example, not a published production setting.

fields.label: Decision
fields.value: Auto-post — 0.94 is at or above the example threshold

steps.title: Write-back confirmation
steps.notice: Only the confirmed code is written back. The corpus grows from a decision the gate accepted, not from the model's first guess.

fields.label: Corpus
fields.value: Appended to the tenant's confirmed lines (simplified)

fields.label: Trace
fields.value: Retrieval, prompt, decision, and confidence recorded in Langfuse
